So here are my notes on how [[ELG]] and its autonumbering was done.

# Before each chapter we declare "uni", "sub" and "subs" using [[:Template:Startchapter]]. <nowiki>{{startchapter|{{#var:uni}}}}</nowiki> might be wrong. See https://mw.lojban.org/index.php?title=ELG._Basic_sentence_elements&action=edit
# [[:Template:Csp]] is for incrementing chapters
# [[:Template:Ssp]] is for incrementing sections
# [[:Template:Ssp]] is for examples (anchors + titles of examples)
# [[:Template:Lch]] and [[:Template:Ls]] are in-text links to chapters and sections.
